Four Parts of Kurdistan

The Kurdish homeland, divided by modern borders but united by culture, language, and history.

Cultural Heritage

Music & Dengbêj

The dengbêj tradition of oral history telling through song, preserving centuries of Kurdish history, love stories, and heroic epics without written records.

Newroz

The Persian New Year celebrated on March 21st, marking the arrival of spring and the legend of Kawa the Blacksmith's victory over the tyrant Zahhak.

Language

Kurdish belongs to the Iranian branch of Indo-European languages, with two main dialects: Kurmanji (Northern) and Sorani (Central), plus Gorani and Zazaki.
